category: multi-hoster (premium link generator, free tier on five hosts)

free_tier.stated: Up to 5 free links per day on 4 free hosts (1fichier, Fshare.vn, Syncs.online, YouTube); the counter resets at 00:00 UTC. Extmatrix is no longer listed as a free host.

per_object_cap.stated: Per host on the free tier: 1fichier 4 GB, Fshare.vn 5 GB, Syncs.online 3 GB, YouTube 60 GB. Extmatrix is no longer listed as a free host.

egress.terms: Direct high-speed links; free access is limited by daily link count and host-specific maximum file size.

interface_detail: Web generator: paste a URL, or a short batch, and receive a direct link. Premium accounts also get a personal Bearer API key with RD-compatible endpoints for automated workflows and third-party downloaders.
tooling: Browser generator on the free path; premium accounts get a Bearer API key with RD-compatible endpoints, and generated HTTPS links work in IDM, NDM, FDM and JDownloader.
chaining: Rapidgator, Nitroflare, K2S and Hot4share stay on the paid plan.

limits.value: free hosts: 1fichier 4 GB, Fshare.vn 5 GB, Syncs.online 3 GB, YouTube 60 GB

binding_note: The 5-links-per-day counter is the first limit a free user meets; the per-host size caps follow.

identity_cost.detail: The free page shows a counter and no sign-up step. Unverified whether the counter is kept per address or per account.

reliability_note: No outage observed on the day read.
confidence_note: First-party free page and home page; the paid plan page answered with a login wall, so its price is unverified.
